subject: Urgent: sustained latency spike + 5xx — request for remediation & commercial makeup
messages:
From: Arjun Mehta <arjun@dataflux.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, support@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@dataflux.com
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency and 5xx surge — immediate remediation + credit request

Jonas / Redwood Support team,

We saw a sustained latency increase and a 5xx error spike affecting our inference pipelines starting 2028-04-21 22:30 UTC and continuing through several hours. The impact knocked several batches offline and forced us to fall back to a cached model instance which degraded quality for end users. Our SREs attached a short CSV with the error/time slices (dataflux_impact_log.csv).

This incident materially affected throughput for our critical production flows during a high-traffic window. Per our SLA (section 2.3) we expect you to propose remediation actions and commercial makeup/credits for the period of degraded service. Please outline:

- Root-cause summary and timeline (we need preliminary notes within 24 hours)
- Immediate mitigations you've applied and their timeline
- Preliminary credit calculation and an ask of when a provisional credit can be applied
- Plan for preventing recurrence (engineering milestones and dates)

We are scheduling a cross-functional call for Monday to align — procurement is looped in for credit/contract discussions.

Thanks,
Arjun
Head of Platform Reliability
DataFlux, Inc.

Attachments: dataflux_impact_log.csv (CSV, 24 KB)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Arjun Mehta <arjun@dataflux.com>, support@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency and 5xx surge — immediate remediation + credit request

Arjun — thanks for the heads up and the impact log. I’m sorry for the disruption. Short note to confirm we’ve opened an incident (INC-2028-DF-041) and engineering is running an accelerated investigation. Immediate items we’ve done:

- Rolled back the recent autoscaling policy change in your region (applied 22:50 UTC)
- Forced routing to a fallback replica set to reduce tail latency spike at 23:10 UTC
- Increased retry window for your customer namespace to limit 5xx propagation

I’ve scheduled a 30-min remediation sync for Monday 08:00 PT and looped Vivek + Priyom for commercial and contract coordination. We’ll send a preliminary credit calc after the forensic log review (target: 24 hours).

Provisional ask from our side: allow us 48 hours for the deeper KV cache replay analysis — we’ll provide a tentative credit number in that window.

Jonas Weber
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Arjun Mehta <arjun@dataflux.com>, procurement@dataflux.com
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency and 5xx surge — immediate remediation + credit request

Team — FYI and next steps from commercial: thanks for fast work on the mitigation so far. For the credit framework, propose we follow a pragmatic, auditable approach:

1) Define impacted window: 2028-04-21T22:30:00Z to 2028-04-22T01:45:00Z (contingent on log validation)
2) Calculate service-unavailable percentage for the account during that window (tokens failing / total tokens served)
3) Apply credit = monthly committed spend * (affected_percentage) * (window_hours / 720) as a provisional number

Using rough early numbers from Arjun’s CSV, preliminary provisional credit = $12,500 (to be finalized after forensic review). We can apply that amount as a one-time invoice credit within two billing cycles while we finish root-cause.

Priyom — please prepare a draft credit calc workbook (I’d expect an attached XLSX) and loop Legal if any contract amendment is required for the makeup. Jonas — confirm the remediation milestones we’ll commit to (engineering cadence).

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft_credit_calc.xlsx (workbook stub)
From: Arjun Mehta <arjun@dataflux.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@dataflux.com
Date: Mon, 23 Apr 2028 08:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency and 5xx surge — immediate remediation + credit request

Thanks Jonas / Vivek — we appreciate the quick mitigation. Procurement: we need a written provisional credit and a contract amendment template showing the agreed commercial makeup and any clause edits (if needed). For timing: a provisional credit applied to the May invoice (two billing cycles) would be acceptable.

Two asks before the call:
- Can you produce the initial root-cause notes and the draft credit worksheet prior to the Monday sync?
- Confirm who from engineering will own the postmortem and the timeline for the preventive work (we need dates we can share with our execs).

I’ll be on the call at 08:00 PT.

—Arjun

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Arjun Mehta <arjun@dataflux.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@dataflux.com
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency and 5xx surge — immediate remediation + credit request

Arjun / team — follow-up from today’s remediation sync and agreed commercial path:

Summary and immediate commitments:
- Impact window (validated): 2028-04-21 22:30 UTC — 2028-04-22 01:45 UTC
- Provisional commercial makeup: $12,500 credit to be applied to the May invoice (provisional, payable as invoice credit within two billing cycles)
- Root cause (preliminary): autoscaling policy misconfiguration combined with hot-shard KV cache eviction leading to elevated tail latency and transient 5xx. Engineering will publish the final postmortem within 7 days.
- Remediation milestones:
  * 48 hours: full KV replay analysis and mitigation checklist completed (owner: eng-oncall)
  * 7 days: permanent autoscaling policy rollback + monitoring guardrails (owner: infra-team)
  * 30 days: postmortem + regression test added to model-release pipeline (owner: platform-eng)

Contract/commercial mechanics:
- We will provisionally apply the $12,500 credit; Legal will prepare a short amendment confirming the makeup and that any final adjustment remains subject to final log reconciliation. Draft doc link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/0B-dataflux-incident-2028-04
- Priyom will send the draft credit workbook and the amendment PDF for signature.

Next steps for this thread:
1) Jonas to share the incident summary and the published postmortem when available
2) Priyom to circulate the draft amendment and credit worksheet by EOD Wednesday
3) Weekly check-in for 3 weeks (Wednesdays) to monitor rollout and any residual issues

Appreciate the collaboration — we’ll treat this as a high-priority remediation stream and keep Procurement / your execs updated.

Jonas Weber
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Attachment: makeup_agreement_20280424.pdf (provisional amendment, 38 KB)
